title: LinguaCroatica - Videos
description: This podcast is ideal for beginners who are starting their journey with the Croatian language. It’s designed to help you get familiar with the language and is perfect for A1-B1 levels. Each episode will cover everyday topics, featuring clear and easy-to-follow standard Croatian.🎧🇭🇷
